scripts.demo: AUTH_DISABLED=true API_BIND_HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=4000 API_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4000 pnpm --parallel --filter @council/api --filter @council/web dev
scripts.test:deploy: for test in ./deploy/scripts/*.test.sh; do bash "$test" || exit $?; done
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:policy && pnpm run test:e2e:build && E2E_DEPLOYMENT_CLASS=disposable E2E_DISPOSABLE_MARKER=council-agent-meeting-platform-disposable-e2e-v1 playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:container: pnpm run test:e2e:policy && pnpm run test:e2e:build && bash ./deploy/scripts/run-disposable-e2e-container.sh
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:deploy && pnpm run build
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:release && pnpm run test:deploy && pnpm run build
